heroDescription: Bring HTML / CSS into Figma, connect Lottie and SVG to a shared animation model, convert between GE, IR, and DSL in both directions, and bring GLSL shaders into Galacean Effects.
manualIntro: A manual organized as a learning path: understand the model and conversion paths first, then import, edit, and finish with practices and limits.
packages.animation-ir.description: Source-neutral 2D animation types, keyframes, and model validation.
packages.dsl-ir.description: Convert between IR and editable DSL; paired preservation data supports editing and reconstruction.
packages.ge-ir.description: Bidirectional conversion between Galacean Effects JSONScene and Animation IR.
packages.html2figma.description: Extract HTML / CSS layout, text, and images into Figma Scene data, clipboard content, or .fig files.
packages.figma2ge.description: Decode Figma .fig files into GE scenes. Work in progress; some features are approximated or omitted.
packages.lottie2ir.description: Convert supported layers and animation from Lottie JSON / ZIP into Animation IR.
packages.shader2ge.description: Wrap main() / mainImage fragment shaders in GE scenes with materials, textures, and timelines.
packages.svg2ir.description: Convert SVG into IR, GE scenes, or static text/image layers, with optional SVG-specific preservation data.
heroArtworkLabel: Conversion map: Lottie and SVG to IR; bidirectional GE and IR, DSL and IR; HTML / CSS to Figma, Figma to GE; GLSL shaders to GE. Each converter supports a defined feature subset.
pathSectionTitle: From web to design. From motion to runtime.
pathSectionDescription: Eight independent packages, composed as needed. Bidirectional does not mean lossless; see each package for coverage, diagnostics, and preservation data.
pathImportDescription: Lottie and SVG enter a shared 2D animation model. SVG also exports GE scenes or static layers.
pathTransformDescription: Compose the model and adapters explicitly, keeping editable data paired with its preservation sidecars.
pathDesignTitle: From a web page to an editable design
pathDesignDescription: Capture a page as editable design data, then use the separate .fig converter to enter GE.
pathRenderTitle: Bring shaders into the animation runtime
conversionGuide: Explore conversion paths, examples, and limitations
